what_happened.line: The Finance Committee took no votes; it heard the town manager's preliminary fiscal 2022 budget covering revenues, spending, the capital plan and the retirement assessment.
The presentation said a premium holiday and a low renewal rate reduce the health insurance line, and that free cash funds the capital plan, OPEB and stabilization deposits.
The preliminary budget leaves an unappropriated balance to backfill increases, and the state announced a second round of school relief funding.
Members questioned the insurance savings, trash contract, capital and stabilization funds; the finance director gave the special purpose stabilization balance and fire equipment needs.
The committee set the 25 February meeting for 6 pm on debt and OPEB, and will set aside April time for a policy on oversight of off-budget spending.

why_it_matters: This is the first look at the budget that sets next year's tax levy, and how much free cash and health insurance savings are used will shape what is left to cover increases and what the tax bill carries.
An off-budget spending oversight policy would decide how much spending outside the voted budget is reviewed before Town Meeting.
